headline: Run Claude Code on a Timer
summary: Discover six reliable methods to automate Claude Code executions on a schedule, ranging from local operating system schedulers to robust cloud pipelines and containerized runners.

slides.title: Tired of manual AI coding tasks?
slides.subtitle: Discover how to schedule autonomous AI runs effortlessly.
slides.body: Imagine your codebase improving overnight without lifting a finger. How do you transition from manual prompts to fully automated scheduled routines?
slides.deep_dive: Manual AI execution limits developers to synchronous workflows. Automating routines unlocks overnight code reviews and automated refactoring loops.
slides.key_fact: Transitioning from manual triggers to timed execution scales engineering productivity.
slides.why_it_matters: Saves hours of repetitive daily engineering overhead.

slides.title: Six Ways to Run on a Timer
slides.subtitle: Comparing local setup versus cloud runners.

slides.key_fact: Choosing the right tier depends entirely on security and infrastructure maturity.
slides.why_it_matters: Prevents unexpected downtime during unattended execution.

slides.deep_dive: Reliable automation demands strict isolation between execution runs to prevent stale state corruption.
slides.key_fact: State persistence is the backbone of stable unattended runs.
slides.why_it_matters: Ensures predictable and repeatable code modifications.

slides.title: Infrastructure Blueprint
slides.subtitle: Mapping scheduler layers to the AI engine.
slides.body: The scheduler communicates directly with container isolation layers, passing secure API credentials to the language model.

slides.deep_dive: Automated workflows bridge the gap between static code analysis and dynamic generative problem solving.
slides.key_fact: Standardized inputs yield consistent, reviewable code outputs.
slides.why_it_matters: Simplifies human oversight for autonomous code changes.

slides.title: Avoiding Unattended Pitfalls
slides.subtitle: Balancing autonomy with safety guards.
slides.body: Running AI loops without guardrails can cause runaway token costs or infinite error loops. Always enforce strict execution limits.
slides.deep_dive: Autonomous coding agents require boundary conditions just like human junior developers.
slides.key_fact: Safety guards protect both your budget and your codebase integrity.
slides.why_it_matters: Prevents catastrophic unintended modifications in production.
